title: Blackbox vNext Reference Observation Profile Schema (Slice 0)
description: Portable governed-path / ignore profile (sensor config). .blackbox/** fixed exclusion. baseline pins profile identity/hash.

fixed_exclusions.description: FIXED exclusions (not user-overridable in reference profile).

profile_identity_sha256.description: sha256 over RFC8785 canonical bytes of the complete observation-profile object with `profile_identity_sha256` omitted (including schema_version), no trailing LF. Format: 'sha256:' + 64 lowercase hex chars. Pinned in observation baseline.
